title: Parts of Speech Identification Decision Tree
subject: Polity
caption: Decision tree for identifying the part of speech of an underlined word.
altText: A flowchart starting at 'Start' leading to a series of yes/no questions. Each question node asks about the function of the underlined word, branching to either a specific part of speech (Verb, Noun, Adjective, Adverb, Intensifier, Conjunction, Pronoun, Article, Interjection) or to the next question. If none apply, the flow ends at 'Other / Unidentified'.
